title: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.29523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deployment: documents can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the low-latency 0.6B model. Both models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2.

translated_abstract: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 pplx-embed-v2-late，这是一对参数量分别为 0.6B 和 9B 的多语言、多模态后期交互（late-interaction）模型。两款模型在各自规模级别中，于一系列文本、图像和视觉文档检索基准测试上均取得了最先进的结果。在视觉文档检索任务上，pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b 与比它大数倍的模型相比也具有竞争力。这些模型通过从一个 18B 参数的教师模型进行表示蒸馏而训练得到。因此，它们共享一个嵌入空间，支持非对称部署：可以使用 9B 模型对文档建立索引，并使用低延迟的 0.6B 模型进行查询。两款模型均可在 https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2 获取。
tldr: Perplexity 推出的 pplx-embed-v2-late 包含 0.6B 和 9B 两个多语言多模态后期交互模型，通过 18B 教师模型的表示蒸馏训练，在文本、图像和视觉文档检索上达到同规模最先进水平，并借助共享嵌入空间支持“9B 建索引、0.6B 低延迟查询”的非对称部署。
en_tdlr: pplx-embed-v2-late introduces 0.6B and 9B multilingual, multimodal late-interaction models distilled from an 18B teacher, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval results on text, image, and visual document benchmarks, with a shared embedding space enabling asymmetric deployment (indexing with the 9B model and low-latency querying with the 0.6B model).
